# Third-party: Tesseract.js

Self-hosted copy of [Tesseract.js](https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js) 5.1.1 (worker + tesseract.js-core),
plus `eng.traineddata.gz` from [tessdata](https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tessdata).
